# IZDOOM v0.17.1

The files in this directory are from the [official v0.17.1 release](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZDOOM/releases/tag/v0.17.1) at commit `3b2554036bcecb368a3d01cce1f43cdb8027138c`. `SHA256SUMS` is the upstream release checksum manifest. The source archive contains the build instructions, GPL source, and license notices for the bundled DOOM shareware data.

mac2jb verifies the original `IZDOOM-v0.17.1-IZ2S.izm` and extracts its `switch/` GPU app into MintBrew's `apps/izdoom` folder. The app manifest already declares `hblauncher.gpu-app` ABI 1 and has no host service. The DOOM shareware data and license notices accompany the staged app. The original release archive and matching source remain alongside this note. Console behavior still requires testing on a Switch 2.
